outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS...MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A SERIES OF EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA FROM THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY TO WY THIS MORNING WILL EJECT NEWD OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT...ALONG THE ERN PERIPHERY OF A LARGE-SCALE TROUGH OVER THE NRN ROCKIES AND GREAT BASIN. THE INITIAL SRN WY SPEED MAX WILL BE ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK SURFACE WAVE ALONG A SLOW-MOVING FRONT ACROSS THE DAKOTAS THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT...WHILE A LEE CYCLONE WILL BE MAINTAINED ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. ONGOING CONVECTION ALONG THE FRONT IN ND SHOULD PERSIST INTO THE DAY...WITH SOME POTENTIAL FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS. THE SEVERE RISK OF MORE CONSEQUENCE WILL MATERIALIZE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WHERE NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG THE FRONT NEAR THE WEAK SURFACE WAVE. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS EARLY IN THE STORM EVOLUTION...AS AFTERNOON TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WELL INTO THE 60S BOOST MLCAPE TO THE 2000-3000 J/KG RANGE. LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE INITIAL MORE DISCRETE STORMS. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND MOISTURE ARE EXPECTED TO BE MORE FAVORABLE FOR TORNADIC STORMS W

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE CENTRAL/NORTHERN PLAINS INTO SOUTHERN WY...

sections.title: CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: RECENT WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A FAST-MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER UT. LIFT AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE IS CURRENTLY AIDING SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ALONG A BAND FROM SOUTH-CENTRAL WY INTO NORTHWEST CO. THIS SYSTEM AND ASSOCIATED LIFT WILL SPREAD EASTWARD TODAY AND IMPINGE ON RICHER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE OVER SD/NEB BY LATE AFTERNOON...LEADING TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT INITIAL STORMS OVER SOUTHEAST WY/WESTERN NEB/SOUTHWEST SD WILL LIKELY BE SUPERCELLULAR WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. AS THE ACTIVITY BUILDS EAST-NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE EVENING...AN EVOLUTION TO MULTIPLE BOWING LINE SEGMENTS IS FORECAST...ENHANCING THE RISK OF MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS. HAVE EXPANDED THE ENHANCED RISK AREA SLIGHTLY FARTHER EAST AND NORTHEAST TO ACCOUNT FOR RECENT MODEL RUNS SUGGESTING GREATER COVERAGE OF INTENSE STORMS IN THIS AREA. OTHERWISE...FEW CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO ONGOING FORECAST. ..HART/GLEASON.. 09/04/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTH CENTRAL PLAINS...PARTICULARLY ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA AND NEBRASKA.

sections.title: 20Z OUTLOOK UPDATE
sections.text: SOME MODIFICATIONS TO THE OUTLOOK HAVE BEEN MADE...BASED LARGELY ON ONGOING TRENDS CONCERNING DESTABILIZATION. SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL IS COMPLICATED SOMEWHAT BY THE CURRENT POSITION OF A MODEST SOUTHERLY 850 MB JET...WHICH STILL EXTENDS ALONG AN AXIS ACROSS CENTRAL KANSAS AND THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...IN THE WAKE OF THE SIGNIFICANT UPPER IMPULSE NOW CROSSING HUDSON BAY. ADDITIONALLY...LOW CLOUD COVER...GENERALLY ASSOCIATED WITH RAIN-COOLED AIR FROM PRIOR CONVECTION...PERSISTS ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN NEBRASKA INTO EASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA...INHIBITING SURFACE HEATING ACROSS THAT AREA. AND...THE MOST SIGNIFICANT LINGERING UPSTREAM SHORT WAVE IMPULSE IS STILL OVER SOUTHEASTERN OREGON/WESTERN NEVADA...AND FORECAST TO ONLY GRADUALLY TURN EASTWARD THEN NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE MONTANA/NORTHERN WYOMING ROCKIES TONIGHT. HOWEVER...A MUCH MORE SUBTLE IMPULSE DOES APPEAR TO BE IN THE PROCESS OF PROGRESSING ACROSS AND NORTHEAST OF THE WYOMING/COLORADO ROCKIES...AND GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO SUGGEST THAT THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS WESTERN INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA AND NEBRASKA...AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF THE PLAINS

sections.title: NORTH CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: CONVECTIVE MODE REMAINS A LITTLE UNCLEAR...BUT DESPITE WEAKNESS IN THE LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS...DEEP LAYER SHEAR BENEATH 35-40+ KT SOUTHWESTERLY 500 MB FLOW APPEARS SUFFICIENTLY STRONG FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING ISOLATED SUPERCELLS IN AT LEAST INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. A NORTHWARD ADVANCING ZONE OF STRONGER DIFFERENTLY SURFACE HEATING MAY PROVIDE ONE FOCUS FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHWEST INTO CENTRAL NEBRASKA...WHERE THE LATEST RAPID REFRESH INDICATES SUBSTANTIVE STRENGTHENING OF SOUTHERLY 850 MB FLOW THROUGH THE 01-04Z TIME FRAME. ENLARGEMENT OF LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS IN THE PRESENCE OF INCREASING BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE MAY CONTRIBUTE TO THE RISK FOR TORNADOES...BEFORE FORCING FOR ASCENT POSSIBLY SUPPORTS AN UPSCALE GROWING CLUSTER OF STORMS.

sections.title: EASTERN GREAT BASIN
sections.text: LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS INDICATES FAIRLY SUBSTANTIVE DESTABILIZATION IS ONGOING ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHEASTERN UTAH/NORTHWESTERN COLORADO THROUGH WESTERN WYOMING...IN ADVANCE OF THE SIGNIFICANT OREGON/NEVADA IMPULSE. THIS ENVIRONMENT MAY BE CONDUCIVE TO AT LEAST MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND WIND GUSTS IN STRONGEST STORMS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. ..KERR.. 09/04/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1116 AM CDT SUN SEP 04 2016/

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR PARTS OF THE CNTRL PLAINS...DAKOTAS...AND FAR WRN MN... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR MUCH OF THE CNTRL/NRN PLAINS INTO MN...

sections.title: CNTRL/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER IMPULSE MOVING OUT OF THE CNTRL ROCKIES IS PARTIALLY AIDING IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED CONVECTION OVER THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS...INCLUDING A FEW DISCRETE SUPERCELLS. WHILE PRIMARY THREATS SHOULD REMAIN DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL...A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL NEB. RECENT OBSERVATIONAL DATA SHOW A WEAK BAROCLINIC ZONE ORIENTED NW-SE ACROSS NEB...AND IS ALIGNED WITH A RELATIVE MAXIMUM IN LOW-LEVEL SRH. A TRANSITION TO A WELL-ORGANIZED CLUSTER APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY NEAR A COLD FRONT OVER WRN SD/NEB...AND THIS EVOLUTION SHOULD CONTINUE AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS THIS EVENING. DMGG WIND GUST THREAT SHOULD BE MAINTAINED LATE TONIGHT INTO EARLY MON MORNING INTO ERN PORTIONS OF THE DAKOTAS AND FAR WRN MN...AS A MOIST/RELATIVELY UNSTABLE INFLOW ENVIRONMENT IS MAINTAINED DESPITE THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING. ..ROGERS.. 09/05/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW OCCURRENCES OF HAIL APPROACHING OR LOCALLY EXCEEDING SEVERE DIAMETER SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH ADDITIONAL STRONGER STORMS THAT DEVELOP ALONG A COLD FRONT IN EASTERN ND THIS MORNING. OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED TO BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR WW ISSUANCE WITH THESE MORNING STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED AN INCREASE IN STORM DEVELOPMENT AND INTENSITY IN EASTERN ND...FROM NELSON TO STUTSMAN COUNTIES. GIVEN RECENT SURFACE AND STREAMLINE ANALYSES...THESE STORMS APPEAR TO BE LOCATED ALONG AN EASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT. SURFACE-BASED DESTABILIZATION HAS BEEN HINDERED SO FAR THIS MORNING...GIVEN CLOUDINESS ACROSS NORTH AND NORTHWEST MN INTO MOST OF ND AND FAR NORTHERN SD. HOWEVER...12Z UPPER AIR ANALYSIS INDICATED MODEST LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION INTO EASTERN ND. THIS COUPLED WITH SOME MIDLEVEL COOLING AND STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT...LIKELY SPREADING ACROSS EASTERN ND ATTENDANT TO AN APPARENT LOW-AMPLITUDE MIDLEVEL TROUGH PER WATER-VAPOR IMAGERY...IS AUGMENTING UPDRAFT STRENGTH. SLOW WARMING OF SURFACE TEMPERATURES DUE TO THE AFOREMENTIONED CLOUDS SHOULD MAINTAIN A GREATER LIKELIHOOD FOR STORMS TO BE PRIMARILY ELEVATED AND/OR...AT BEST...NEAR SURFACE BASED THROUGH THE LATE MORNING. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES COULD PROVE FAVORABLE FOR SOME HAIL APPROACHING AND/OR LOCALLY EXCEEDING 1 INCH IN DIAMETER. VEERED LOW-LEVEL WINDS IN NORTHEAST SD PER ABR VAD WILL LIMIT CONVERGENCE AND STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT. AS THE MIDLEVEL IMPULSE MOVES NORTHEAST INTO SOUTHERN MANITOBA...AN EVENTUAL DECREASE IN UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION AND LOW-LEVEL WARM AIR ADVECTION SHOULD RESULT IN A DECREASED POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER STORMS IN EASTERN ND...AT LEAST BY EARLY AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INITIAL DISCRETE STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH 22Z ACROSS SOUTHEAST WY AND NORTHEAST CO INTO ADJACENT SOUTHWEST SD AND THE WESTERN PART OF THE NEB PANHANDLE. THESE INITIAL STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING PRIMARILY HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. A FURTHER INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND SEVERITY /PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS/ IS EXPECTED FROM NORTHEAST CO THROUGH THE NEB PANHANDLE TO SOUTHWEST SD BY 23Z...WITH STORMS SPREADING TO THE EAST-NORTHEAST THROUGH THE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN SATELLITE IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA SUGGESTED THE LEADING EXTENT OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...LOCATED IN CENTRAL WY TO NORTHWEST CO AT 19Z...IS MOVING INTO EASTERN WY AND NORTH-CENTRAL TO NORTHEAST CO. THIS INCREASE IN UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION IS SUPPORTING TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG ITS LEADING EDGE FROM SOUTH-CENTRAL TO SOUTHEAST WY...AND PERHAPS THE NEWLY FORMED STORMS IN NORTHEAST CO AND WITHIN UPSLOPE FLOW ACROSS SOUTHWEST SD. INSTABILITY IS GENERALLY MARGINAL IN THESE AFOREMENTIONED STORM LOCATIONS...THOUGH BULK SHEAR HAS BEEN STRENGTHENING THIS AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN CO/WY TO CENTRAL NEB/SD. THE CAPE/SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE WITH THE INITIAL STORMS SHOULD SUPPORT PRIMARILY A THREAT FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. MEANWHILE...SURFACE ANALYSES INDICATED A STALLED FRONT EXTENDING FROM NORTHEAST ND TO CENTRAL SD TO THE NORTHWEST NEB PANHANDLE...WITH AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE LOCATED ALONG THIS BOUNDARY NEAR PIR...AND A SECOND AREA OF LOW PRESSURE EXTENDING FROM EAST-CENTRAL TO SOUTHEAST WY. AS THE LEADING EDGE OF LIFT ATTENDANT TO THE WY/CO SHORTWAVE TROUGH SPREADS TO THE EAST-NORTHEAST ATOP RICHER ENVIRONMENTAL MOISTURE/INSTABILITY FROM FAR NORTHEAST CO THROUGH WESTERN NEB AND SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL SD...STORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE MAIN THREATS...SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER CO/WY EMBEDDED WITH LARGE-SCALE TROUGHING OVER THE WRN CONUS EJECTS NEWD THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION WILL LIKELY SPREAD EWD/NEWD FROM FAR ERN CO INTO WRN KS. FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH COMBINED WITH LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG LEE TROUGHING ACROSS ERN CO HAS ENCOURAGED ISOLATED CONVECTION TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF SERN CO AS OF 1945Z. THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY IS ON THE WRN FRINGE OF BETTER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IN PLACE ACROSS WRN KS PER SFC OBSERVATIONS AND LATEST RAP MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES. AS THESE ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS MOVE EWD INTO WRN KS...THEY WILL ENCOUNTER A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS...WITH 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES AROUND 7.0-7.5 DEG C/KM SUPPORTING MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. 35-40 KT MID-LEVEL WINDS ATTENDANT TO THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL SUPPORT UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION AS SLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS VEER TO SWLY WITH HEIGHT. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES AROUND 35-45 KT...INITIAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT WILL LIKELY BE SUPERCELLULAR AND POSE AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND RISK. A MEASURED SEVERE GUST OF 53 KT WAS RECORDED AT KLAA IN SERN CO AT 1859Z WITH ONE SUCH THUNDERSTORM. THESE ISOLATED STORMS IN FAR ERN CO MAY GROW UPSCALE WITH TIME INTO SMALL BOWING SEGMENTS AS A SLY LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS ACROSS KS THIS EVENING. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP WITHIN A WEAK WAA ADVECTION REGIME THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS WRN KS. REGARDLESS...THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER ISOLATED THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING AS BETTER FORCING AND STRONGER WINDS ALOFT REMAIN GENERALLY DISPLACED TO THE N OF WRN KS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SEVERE-WEATHER WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST/NORTHEAST OF WW 465 ACROSS MAINLY CENTRAL SD THROUGH THIS EVENING. IF CURRENT TRENDS OF INCREASING STORMS/INTENSITY PERSIST ACROSS THE NORTH AND NORTHEAST PORTIONS OF WW 465...THEN THIS WATCH ISSUANCE WILL NEED TO OCCUR SOONER THAN PREVIOUSLY EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY...SINCE 20Z...SHOWED AN INCREASE IN STORM DEVELOPMENT/INTENSITY...WHILE IR SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED RAPIDLY COOLING CLOUD TOPS WITH THESE STORMS IN OGLALA LAKOTA TO JACKSON COUNTIES SOUTH DAKOTA. THESE STORMS WERE LOCATED IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE BOUNDARY EXTENDING SOUTHWESTWARD FROM AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IN CENTRAL SD /NEAR PIR/...WITH THIS SAME BOUNDARY EXTENDING TO THE NORTHEAST INTO NORTH-CENTRAL SD TO EASTERN ND. THE AIR MASS FROM CENTRAL/WESTERN NEB THROUGH CENTRAL SD HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH SOME INCREASE IN BULK SHEAR EXPECTED. GIVEN THE LIKELIHOOD FOR ONGOING STORMS AND ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT TO SPREAD INTO CENTRAL SD THROUGH THIS EVENING...A NEW WW WILL BE NEEDED...WITH THAT ISSUANCE POSSIBLE SOONER...IF STRONGER STORM INTENSITIES IN NORTHERN PART OF 465 ARE SUSTAINED IN THE SHORT TERM. SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS DOWNSTREAM OF WW 465.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA...WITH MORE CONCENTRATED DAMAGING WINDS LIKELY BECOMING AN INCREASING THREAT THROUGH THE EVENING AS STORMS MERGE INTO LINES AND BOWING SEGMENTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR COMPOSITE AT 2255Z SHOWS SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS ACROSS WW 465...WITH A GRADUAL INCREASE IN COVERAGE NOTED SINCE 22Z. A COLD FRONT EXTENDED FROM NORTH-CENTRAL INTO SOUTHWEST SD...WITH STORMS FARTHER SOUTH NEAR A SURFACE TROUGH/CONFLUENCE ZONE. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE WATCH AREA REMAINS CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE-LOCALLY STRONG MIXED-LAYER INSTABILITY AND 45-55 KTS OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...AND SEVERAL SUPERCELLS/STORM SPLITS HAVE BEEN OBSERVED WITH LONG-LIVED LEFT- AND RIGHT-MOVING STORMS. IN THE SHORT TERM...A LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL CONTINUE WITH SUPERCELLS/CLUSTERS ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED SIG SEVERE HAIL ALSO REMAINS POSSIBLE. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE LIFTING NORTHEAST ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...AND INCREASING WARM ADVECTION WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD HELP PROMOTE UPSCALE GROWTH INTO BOWING SEGMENTS THIS EVENING WITH AN INCREASED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS. RAP FORECAST SOUNDING HODOGRAPHS SHOW SUBSTANTIAL LOW-LEVEL CURVATURE THIS EVENING AND ANY SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELL WILL HAVE SOME RISK FOR A TORNADO...ESPECIALLY AS STORMS MOVE EAST ACROSS THE NEB PORTION OF THE WW AREA. ..BUNTING.. 09/04/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DEEP CONVECTION SHOULD EXPAND IN AREAL COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND SOME DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL DEVELOPING CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ARE NOTED ACROSS THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS THIS EVENING. ONE EVOLVING CLUSTER IS EXPANDING NEWD ACROSS CNTRL SD ALONG/JUST AHEAD OF THE SYNOPTIC FRONT DRAPED ACROSS THIS REGION. LARGE HAIL IS LIKELY WITH THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS...ESPECIALLY OVER PARTS OF LYMAN COUNTY SD PER LATEST MRMS DATA. OVER THE LAST HOUR OR SO...POST-FRONTAL CONVECTION HAS GRADUALLY INCREASED FROM NEAR THE SD BORDER OVER MCINTOSH COUNTY ND...ARCING NNEWD ALONG THE COOL SIDE OF THE BOUNDARY INTO NWRN MN. THESE ELEVATED STORMS HAVE YET TO ATTAIN SIGNIFICANT INTENSITY...ALTHOUGH SMALL HAIL IS LIKELY OCCURRING WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. IF THIS ACTIVITY CAN PROPAGATE INTO THE WARM SECTOR OVER SERN ND THERE WILL LIKELY BE INTENSIFICATION SUCH THAT LARGER HAIL AND POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WINDS COULD DEVELOP. LLJ IS FORECAST TO INCREASE ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND THIS SHOULD ENABLE UPSCALE-EVOLVING CLUSTERS AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES ACROSS THE ENTIRE WATCH AREA. ..DARROW.. 09/04/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SUPERCELL OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING...WITH A RISK FOR A TORNADO ALONG WITH LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING GUSTS. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR EITHER A SMALL TORNADO WATCH...OR AN EXPANSION OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH NUMBER 465.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM WAS DEVELOPING APPROXIMATELY 25 MILES WEST-NORTHWEST OF BROKEN BOW NEB AT 0045Z. LATEST MESOANALYSIS REVEALS A MODEST BAROCLINIC ZONE/BUOYANCY GRADIENT IN THIS AREA WHERE PERSISTENT CLOUD COVER TO THE NORTHEAST HAS REDUCED DIURNAL HEATING. ADDITIONALLY...LOW-LEVEL FLOW REMAINS SLIGHTLY BACKED ACROSS CENTRAL NEB...AND COMBINED WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET HAS RESULTED IN EFFECTIVE SRH VALUES ABOVE 250 M2/S2 ALONG AND EAST OF THE DEVELOPING STORM. LCL HEIGHTS ALSO LOWER WITH EASTWARD EXTENT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...AND WILL CONTINUE TO LOWER AS SUBTLE NOCTURNAL COOLING ENSUES. WITH FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...THE ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTS ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING GUSTS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO. GIVEN THE RELATIVELY CONFINED SPATIAL EXTENT OF THE FAVORABLE TORNADO ENVIRONMENT...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR EITHER A SMALL/SHORT-DURATION TORNADO WATCH OR AN AREAL EXTENSION OF WW 465 DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH LINES/CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS THROUGH 04Z...WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE. A RELATIVELY LOCALIZED THREAT FOR A TORNADO EXISTS WITH ISOLATED STORMS ACROSS WESTERN/CENTRAL NEBRASKA FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...WHERE THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WAS RECENTLY EXTENDED EAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WERE IN PROGRESS IN ACROSS WW 465 AT 0155Z...INCLUDING AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED LINEAR SYSTEM ACROSS THE SD/NORTHERN NEB PORTION OF THE WW...CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS OVER NORTHWEST KS...AND MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS OVER WESTERN/CENTRAL NEB. LATEST MESOANALYSIS AND 00Z UPPER AIR DATA SHOW MODERATE-LOCALLY STRONG INSTABILITY /MAXIMIZED OVER CENTRAL NEB/ ACROSS THE REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 465 ALONG WITH 40-55 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. LINEAR/CLUSTER MODES HAVE BECOME MORE PREDOMINANT ACROSS MUCH OF THE WW AREA AS MERGING COLD POOLS AND INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT PROMOTE UPSCALE GROWTH...AND A BOOKEND VORTEX HAS BECOME ESTABLISHED SOUTHEAST OF PHILIP SD WHERE SEVERAL REPORTS OF SEVERE WINDS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED. SEVERE STORMS ACROSS NORTHERN PORTIONS OF THE WW AREA WILL SOON MOVE INTO SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF WW 466 WITH A MORE CONCENTRATED DAMAGING-WIND THREAT THROUGH LATE EVENING. STORMS OVER NORTHWEST KS CONTINUE TO TRANSITION INTO A MORE LINEAR MODE...THOUGH EMBEDDED STRONGER UPDRAFTS SUGGESTS ISOLATED LARGE HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE IN THIS AREA FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. MORE ISOLATED SUPERCELLS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER PORTIONS OF CENTRAL NEB DURING THE PAST 1-2 HOURS. ALTHOUGH AT LEAST SOME TORNADO RISK REMAINS FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS...INCREASING CINH WITH TIME WILL RESULT IN DIMINISHED TORNADO POTENTIAL. REFER TO MCD 1637 FOR DETAILS IN THIS AREA. SOME SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE BEYOND 04Z...AND TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE NEED FOR A NEW WATCH...OR A TEMPORAL/AREAL EXTENSION OF THE EXISTING WATCH...AS THE SCHEDULED EXPIRATION OF WW 465 APPROACHES. ..BUNTING.. 09/05/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT IS INCREASING ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HALF OF WW466.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HIGH PLAINS CONVECTION THAT DEVELOPED OVER SWRN SD/NEB PANHANDLE HAS MATURED INTO A WELL-DEFINED MCS OVER SCNTRL SD. LATEST RADAR DATA SUGGESTS AN MCV HAS FORMED SW OF PIR OVER JONES COUNTY. A BOWING SEGMENT IS SURGING NEWD IN EXCESS OF 40KT IN ADVANCE OF THIS FEATURE AND IS LIKELY GENERATING DAMAGING WINDS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE BOW...ESPECIALLY LYMAN COUNTY SD. THIS COMPLEX SHOULD SPREAD ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN HALF OF WW466 OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP NEAR THE FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING ACROSS NCNTRL SD INTO ERN ND.
